paper.title: Self-Evolving Software Agents
paper.central_claim: BDI推理旁的自动演化模块从环境经验发现新需求，自主改写goal、reasoning和执行代码，通过选择与继承实现超越固定目标适应的软件演化。

provenance.notes: 派发 model type=sonnet，声明映射 gpt-6.1-sol；未独立探测模型，工具未提供可核验 actual_model/session/receipt，故为 null。未读另一席或其他 attempt；未运行收录代码。

sections_read: Figure 1 architecture caption; no appendix in fixed version

reason: 非权重目标/代码的经验反馈留存闭环在范围内；完整短文仅给未展开的定性原型陈述，证据薄弱不等于缺全文。
rationale: 提出BDI旁路演化与成功行为留存，但触发、验收、继承和恢复未落实为可重建协议；无可核查实验结果，不能证明retained或稳定性。

evidence.quote: current agent architectures lack explicit mechanisms to autonomously evolve their own requirements and code while preserving architectural coherence
evidence.support_explanation: 作者gap，未与最近自改写代理直接对照。

evidence.quote: This module monitors the agent’s experience and identifies unmet needs or novel opportunities that cannot be addressed by the current knowledge, goals, or action repertoire.
evidence.support_explanation: 经验触发演化，不仅单回答自修正。

evidence.quote: The evolution process acts on three architectural layers of the agent: (i) knowledge representation and reasoning, by extending or revising perceptual and inference mechanisms; (ii) goal generation and decision making, by introducing new goals and intention-selection policies; and (iii) execution, by synthesizing or adapting executable actions and plans.
evidence.support_explanation: 可变对象是非权重BDI层和代码。

evidence.quote: The agent is initially provided only with a textual description of the environment and a minimal set of APIs, without predefined domain-specific knowledge or goals.
Successful behaviours are retained and reused in subsequent situations, while ineffective ones are discarded.
evidence.support_explanation: 描述选择/留存，无操作定义或跨任务数据。

evidence.quote: Preliminary experiments show that the agent is able to autonomously discover operational goals and generate executable behaviours starting from minimal prior knowledge.
evidence.support_explanation: 仅定性自报，没有实际示例或数值可核。

evidence.quote: These challenges point to the need for reinforcement mechanisms, memory consolidation, and more robust selection strategies.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自己承认选择、稳定和继承未解决。

signatures.information: 环境perceptions、历史experience、环境文字和最小API
signatures.operation: 发现不能解释/利用的perception→需求生成→设计/代码变异→环境交互验证→选择继承
signatures.conditions: 环境可反馈有效性；LLM代码适配API；未定义成功准则
signatures.feedback: 环境交互成功/失败，具体可观测量未给
signatures.selection_rule/data: 仅successful retain/ineffective discard，阈值、任务集、样本未给
signatures.persistence: 声称成功行为保留，格式、版本、回滚和寿命未给
signatures.later_use: subsequent situations，未给后续任务轨迹
signatures.claimed_effect: 自主发现目标和行为并维持coherence
signatures.failure_boundary: 行为继承/稳定性/环境复杂度，均无量化边界

gap.author_gap: 固定设计期目标和能力只允许adaptation，不允许长期software evolution。
gap.checked_gap: 固定目标局限逻辑上可理解，但论文没有定位最近LLM代码自演化/自主技能方法，更无证明BDI旁路弥补特定现有缺陷。

lineage.method: classical BDI与self-adaptive software → LLM需求/代码生成

gap.closest_adjacent: BDI+LLM与trace驱动工具生成/自改写agent；原文未固定最近邻。
gap.residue: 分离reasoning/evolution是否实际保coherence、而不是常规模块化，未检验。
gap.stakes: 开放环境中需求变化与稳定执行
gap.method_response: 把需求/推理/动作均设为可修改对象并以环境反馈选择。
gap.remaining_gap: 未定义安全约束、成功和inheritance语义，无法判别能力累积与一次生成。
unresolved: 请总控共同固定最近BDI–LLM、自改写agent和工具生成原文以核对谱系；本席不联网。
